title: The Ford
text: A river in flood, brown and roaring, carrying whole trees past. The old ford is half under water, its stones slick, the current dragging white around them. On the far bank a cairn marks where the drowned are buried.

options.label: Ford it together, roped, and trust each other to hold.

outcomes.text: Wet, cold, across, and the drowned on the far bank watch you come.
Someone is swept off their feet and dragged under before the rope holds, and the river takes its due.

options.label: The strongest swims a rope over, against the flood.

outcomes.text: A good rope, and dry packs, and arms that burn for a day.

options.label: Wait for the flood to fall, and lose a day to the river.

outcomes.text: A day lost, listening to the river roar, and wondering how many it has taken.
